categories.main_business_segments: Altech Corporation (Alps Giken) operates three main business segments: Outsourcing Services (primarily technical staffing and project-based engineering services for design, CAD, office support, agriculture, and nursing care), Global Business (engineering, installation, and maintenance of plant and equipment, as well as overseas staffing and training), and Other (mainly senior housing with services). The core segment is technical outsourcing, which accounts for the majority of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core capabilities lie in the recruitment, training, and deployment of engineers skilled in mechanical, electrical, and IT design, as well as project management. It emphasizes advanced technical education, including AI, robotics, and environmental technologies, and utilizes both in-house and on-the-job training systems. Manufacturing and development methods are applied in the 'monozukuri' (manufacturing) business, including the development of agricultural robots and custom systems for nursing care providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Altech primarily serves large manufacturers in the automotive, semiconductor, and electronics industries, providing them with highly skilled engineers and project teams. It also targets the agriculture and nursing care sectors for staffing and contract services, and offers engineering solutions to overseas Japanese and local manufacturers. There are no single customers accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets. It also has subsidiaries and business activities in Taiwan, China (Shanghai), and Myanmar, focusing on engineering services and local staffing. The company is expanding its global reach, particularly in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Altech operates primarily as a downstream service provider, delivering technical human resources and engineering solutions directly to end-user manufacturers and service providers. In the global segment, it also acts as a midstream partner for plant engineering and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into new technical outsourcing domains, developing new revenue pillars in agriculture, nursing care, and manufacturing, and contributing to a sustainable society. R&D focuses on integrating technology with human resources, such as developing agricultural robots and in-house systems for care providers, and enhancing digital transformation and advanced technical training (AI, robotics, environmental tech).
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the dispatch (staffing) of engineers and technical personnel, project-based engineering contracts, and human resource services. Additional revenue streams include product development (e.g., agricultural robots), system development for care providers, and service fees from senior housing operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Altech is positioned as a leading technical staffing and engineering outsourcing provider in Japan, competing with other major engineering staffing firms such as Meitec and TechnoPro. Its differentiation lies in its focus on advanced technical training, team-based dispatch, and expansion into agriculture and nursing care sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated sales reached approximately 49.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.16 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.68 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and assets over the past five years, maintaining a high equity ratio (66.6%) and a workforce of over 6,200 employees. Growth is driven by increased staffing demand and expansion into new business areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Altech emphasizes its ability to provide highly skilled, continuously trained engineers who can adapt to advanced technologies and changing customer needs. Its unique value lies in team-based dispatch, customized technical education, and the integration of technology with human resource services, enabling clients to improve operational efficiency and address social challenges in manufacturing, agriculture, and care sectors.
